cards.title: The framework's own site
cards.text: framework.louis-agent.dev: the framework's pages, built on its web like any site.

cards.title: What it is made of
cards.text: Flat, the framework's pages, the docs on GitHub and every place's address.

cards.title: Its frame
cards.text: The docs layout: the menu, the page, the search, and Orbi docked on the right.

cards.title: Its agent
cards.text: The framework Orbi, answering from the docs on the docs and site packs.

cards.title: Its host
cards.text: Runs Orbi, answers the search, and draws each page as HTML, on :5084.
